svg.title: Gradient flow and validation loss in two deep PyTorch networks
svg.desc: The sigmoid network's gradient RMS shrinks sharply toward the input layer, while the ReLU network keeps larger gradients. Over 120 epochs, sigmoid validation loss plateaus near 0.649 while ReLU validation loss reaches 0.533.
